headline: DAB1複合体のクライオ電顕で、活性部位の2状態が見えた
subhead: 状態Aは反応物の入口、状態BはHCO3−の出口とみられる通路が開いていた

summary.question: DAB1 は膜のプロトン勾配と結びつき、CO2 を一方向に水和する炭酸脱水酵素（CA）だが、その仕組みは不明だった。
summary.approach: 好熱菌 Thermocrinis albus の DAB1 複合体をクライオ電顕（2.29 Å）で解き、変異体のスクリーニングも行った。
summary.result: 活性部位は DabA の内部で溶媒から 10 Å 以上奥にあった。3D 分類で、周囲の残基の動きが異なる状態 A と状態 B が得られた。
summary.learned: 状態 A で CO2 と水の入口が開き、状態 B でそれが閉じて HCO3− の出口が開く、という機構が提案された。
summary.open: 活性部位のプロトンを除く最終段階は、構造からは分からない。

question.quote: The mechanism of this vectorial CA activity has remained unclear.
it is an open question how these complexes mechanistically act as vectorial CAs, rather than reversibly catalyzing hydration, as all other CAs do.

approach.quote: To that end, we used cryoelectron microscopy (Cryo-EM) to solve the structure of the DAB1 complex from the thermophile, Thermocrinis albus, to 2.29 Å resolution.
We investigated the molecular basis of this mechanism using a suppressor screen in CAFree

result.quote: In contrast, the DabA active site is buried more than 10 Å from solvent, sequestered by a flexible lid domain comprising residues 471 to 509
We therefore performed 3D classification, which revealed two distinct states with sufficient quality cryo-EM density for model building.

learned.quote: Together, these structures support a model in which the substrates enter through CO2 and water channels for CO2 hydration, after which a transition to State B closes the entry routes and opens a separate exit channel to release HCO3− to the cytosol.

open.quote: Our structural data do not provide an obvious mechanism for the final step in the cycle.

highlights.text: 状態 B では F476 が大きく動いて疎水性の通路 A1 を閉じ、C494 が約 5 Å 動いて水の通路 A2 をふさぐ。同時に G474 と S716 が約 3 Å ずれ、反対側に親水性の通路 B が開く。

evidence.quote: Relative to State A, the GI(A/G)GFFG motif adopts a more helical conformation, forcing F476 to undergo a dramatic movement
Meanwhile, both G474 and S716 shift ~3 Å to open a new hydrophilic channel (Channel B) opposite to the State A channels, which opens to the solvent near the membrane leaflet.

highlights.text: DabA の活性部位は典型的な β 型 CA で、Zn2+ に C449・C709・H694 と水が配位する。HCO3− と水素結合する位置が Leu825 で、HCO3− を放しやすくしている可能性がある。

evidence.quote: Our structural analysis confirms that these residues do in fact form a typical β-CA active site in which a Zn2+ ion is coordinated by two cysteines (C449 and C709), a histidine (H694), and a water in a tetrahedral geometry
It is possible that this lack of an H-bond donor in DabA raises the barrier to HCO3− binding and encourages product release after hydration.

highlights.text: プロトン伝達を壊した DabB の H229A でも空気中で増える DabA 変異体を選ぶと、C494 や N901 の置換が見つかった。通路の閉鎖と DabA–DabB の連結が、共役の維持に必要と解釈されている。

evidence.quote: These mutants highlight two features of the complex that are required to normally maintain coupling: regulation of channel opening and closure, and mechanical linkage to transmit structural changes from the proton translocation pathway to the DabA active site.
Only one tested variant, epS1, which contains a mutation to C494 that likely perturbs the State A - State B transition, demonstrated in vitro CA activity.

lab_notes.expression: T. albus の DAB1 を、DabC の C 末端に His タグを付けて大腸菌 BL21-AI で発現。
lab_notes.purification: LMNG で膜から可溶化し、Ni-IMAC、70 °C 加熱、ゲルろ過で精製。
lab_notes.sample_prep: グラフェンオキサイドを付けた C-Flat 2/2 グリッドに 3 μL（0.06〜0.2 mg/mL）をのせ、Vitrobot Mark IV で凍結。
lab_notes.data_collection: Krios G3i と K3 で 6,032 本のムービーを収集。cryoSPARC で、活性部位にマスクをかけた 3D 分類により 2 状態を分離。
